enrich.rationale: Residual-driven active learning will add new solves exactly where the current winner’s residual model predicts high error/uncertainty, yielding higher RMSE reduction per added sample than blind regeneration or another hyperparameter search.

diagnosis: The surrogate remains sample-bottlenecked with strongly input-structured residuals (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) and stable evaluation noise, so errors are dominated by under-covered/weak regions rather than tuning variance.
